title: File management tools either have duplicate context menu items or none at all in extended menu

judgment.rationale: The only issue build is 0.100.2. The live automated triage comment explicitly asks the reporter to update to 0.101.2362.0 and confirm whether the behavior remains; no reporter follow-up is present. Several symptoms already overlap public tracking, so do not start a competing fix design until the retest establishes what remains uncovered.
evidence: The report identifies PowerToys 0.100.2 from Microsoft Store and names File Locksmith, PowerRename, and Image Resizer.

The public screenshots show each applicable PowerToys command in both the newer/default and lower classic/extended menu areas in combined mode; the extended-only screenshot shows no PowerToys entries.
The last issue comment is GitHub Actions triage at 2026-10-15T06:23:13Z, asking for an update to 0.101.2362.0 and a retest. No author response follows it.
The issue lacks a Needs-Author-Feedback label, but the explicit unanswered request is current; label absence does not satisfy it.
judgment.recommended_action: Wait for a current-stable retest in both menu modes, then separate any remaining File Locksmith behavior from the existing Image Resizer and PowerRename tracking before selecting design work.

fix_assessment.rationale: Existing public coverage is partial, not proof that the whole report is fixed: #20255 is OPEN with Status-In progress for duplicate Image Resizer entries and its 2026-10-09 comment says the duplicate still exists; #30694 is OPEN for PowerRename missing from the context menu. Linked #22307 and #30321 were closed as duplicates of earlier trackers. #49416 is an open feature request about File Locksmith in the classic menu, not a fix for this report. No fork issue, PR, or branch trace exists for #51316. Do not create a duplicate plan for tracked portions; retest is needed to determine remaining scope. URLs: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/20255 ; https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/30694 ; https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/49416

issue_context.summary: The combined context-menu setting shows the three PowerToys commands across both menu surfaces, while selecting extended-only leaves the reporter without any of them; the report is on an older Store build and overlaps existing menu-registration trackers.
known_information: PowerToys 0.100.2, Microsoft Store installation; affected tools are File Locksmith, PowerRename, and Image Resizer (for image selections).
Screenshots show commands in both the newer/default and lower classic/extended menu areas in combined mode, and no PowerToys entries in the extended-only screenshot.
The live triage comment requests an update/retest; the reporter has not replied.

#20255 is OPEN and Status-In progress for Image Resizer duplicate entries; its latest comment says the behavior still exists in October 2026. #30694 is OPEN for PowerRename missing from the context menu. #49416 is an OPEN feature request for File Locksmith in the old context menu, a distinct request.
inferences: The screenshots are consistent with commands registered on more than one Explorer menu surface, but they do not prove the setting is implemented incorrectly.
A current-build retest may show that some reported behavior has changed; if it persists, only the symptoms not already tracked should receive new design work.
issue_context.analysis: The screenshots make the difference between the two settings concrete, but the source version is old and the multi-tool symptoms overlap public issue tracking. The next decision is whether the issue reproduces on a current build and whether File Locksmith or the combined mode reveals a distinct untracked failure.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue body, the entire automated triage comment, and both public screenshots. The screenshots confirm the reported menu placement; no diagnostic archive is attached.

At upstream source head 1b33221dfa19f30d71409eb550807883fb27283a, FileLocksmithContextMenu/AppxManifest.xml, PowerRenameContextMenu/AppxManifest.xml, and ImageResizerContextMenu/AppxManifest.xml contain Windows Explorer context-menu registrations. File Locksmith and PowerRename also have legacy ShellEx registration specifications; Image Resizer uses system-file-association registration. These are multiple registration paths, not evidence of the reported setting bug by themselves.

Linked-history check: #30321 closed as duplicate of #20255; #22307 closed as duplicate of #27622, which later closed as duplicate of #30694; #43576 closed as duplicate of #31547, which closed as duplicate of #30694. #20255 and #30694 remain open. This does not establish that #51316 is fully handled.
Searched MuyuanMS/PowerToys issues, PRs, and matching branch names; no #51316 trace was found.

information_gaps.information: Whether the same files/folders still show duplicates or no entries on the current stable PowerToys build, in each of the two context-menu settings.
information_gaps.why_needed: The report is on 0.100.2 and the live triage comment requested an update; this decides whether the behavior remains and which portions need separate tracking.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Update to the current stable release, repeat the same right-click on a file and folder with Default and extended context menu selected, then repeat with Extended context menu only; report the visible commands for each tool in each mode.
